text:
anika: Dropping a micro-proposal: add a 'Share snippet' action in the stacktrace context menu. It would let support/devs copy a small payload (frame sig, file:line, and the correlation identifier) or generate a short permalink to paste into tickets. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1769990001.png
matt: Love the idea. A few constraints: 1) short permalinks should be explicit about scope (?span=) so callers know if it's full-trace or single-span. 2) copying a snippet should default to a minimal payload (function + file:line + trace_id) to avoid sharing PII.
serena: UX thoughts: make the snippet option a submenu: "Copy snippet" -> options: "Minimal (frame + trace)", "With span (frame + trace:span)", "Full JSON (include timestamp, service)". Default to Minimal. Show a tiny toast on success: "Snippet copied" and include a small link "View in trace" in the toast.
aria: Accessibility checklist: ensure submenu is keyboard-navigable; use role=menu and proper aria-haspopup/aria-expanded attributes. For the copy confirmation use aria-live="polite" with message "Snippet copied to clipboard". Avoid showing full trace id on hover; in expanded view expose the full id inside a focusable element with visually-hidden explanatory text ("32 hex characters") for screen readers.
anika: Microcopy suggestion: use the term "correlation identifier" across UI (tooltips, buttons) rather than "ID". Tooltip text for the snippet action: "Copies a compact context for this frame (function, file:line, correlation identifier)".
matt: Implementation notes: client can do `navigator.clipboard.writeText(payload)` with try/catch and fallback to hidden textarea + `document.execCommand('copy')`. For permalinks, use short tokens like "/t/abcd1234?span=ef12" and include an opt-in checkbox in the Share modal for including span.
serena: For Export placement: prefer keeping a single Export in the kebab but surface a smaller "Quick export" action in the secondary actions row for common cases. Quick export would default to "request-scoped .zip" and immediately queue a job; full-trace export stays in kebab with options. Show an estimated size badge before queuing if possible.
aria: Accessibility & contrast: export quick-action must have >=4.5:1 contrast and a visible focus ring. For the estimated size badge use text (eg "~1.2 MB") not just icons so screen readers convey it. Expose the estimate in a visually-hidden span as well.
anika: On privacy: Full JSON and HAR exports should present a scrub modal where user can toggle "Remove headers" and "Remove bodies". If user enables bodies, show a red lock icon and require an explicit checkbox "I confirm I have permissions to export request bodies" for enterprise orgs.
matt: Backend follow-ups: exports are queued (`POST /api/exports` -> returns job_id, estimated_bytes, requires_approval). Enforce rate limits and add audit entries with user, scope, size estimate, and job_id. Download links should be signed URLs with TTL. File naming convention: `trace_<shortid>_<YYYYMMDD>.zip`.
serena: UX flow for downloads panel: new entry shows job with progress, ETA, size, actions: "Copy link", "Copy manifest JSON", "Delete". In the trace view toast after queuing include a small "Go to Downloads" link.
aria: Keyboard & screen reader flows: ensure the Share modal traps focus, the copy buttons are regular buttons, and toasts are reachable via an alert region or an announcements list. When copying manifest JSON, announce "Export manifest copied".
anika: Small detail on copy behavior: default copy for inline snippet = trace_id only; in Share modal checkbox "Include span id" controls whether we copy trace_id:span_id. This keeps integrations stable by default.
matt: Also add telemetry event `share_snippet` with fields: user_id, scope, option_selected (minimal|span|full), and org_id. Useful for product to see adoption.
preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1769990001  feedback open for 72h :calendar:
